put.summary: Set up the account: chain owner, sharing key, then key bundle
put.description: Two calls. First, after the client creates the master key and registers the recovery code: the owner proof and sharing key create the account. Then, once the key bundle is stored (POST /v1/objects, kind key_bundle), the same call with keyBundleCid points the account at it. Dashboard sessions only.

post.summary: Share a space or a file
post.description: Pass wrappedKeyCid when the recipient has a sharing key: for a space, a keyring sealed to them through the current epoch (keyEpoch); for a file, its manifest re-sealed to them. Both are stored first as grant key objects. Without a key the grant is pending until the recipient sets up MemDot and your client completes it.

get.summary: Grants your client should wrap a key for now
get.description: Called after unlocking. pending: the recipient has set up MemDot since you shared. rotated: a revoke moved the space to a new epoch, so a grant still active needs a keyring through it. Wrap, store the grant key, then complete each one (P5).
